semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Tusen Laser Co., Ltd specializes in high-end laser processing equipment used for precision drilling and cutting of materials relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Suzhou Tusen Laser Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of advanced laser processing equipment. Their products are widely utilized for precision hole drilling and cutting of brittle materials such as ultra-thin glass and sapphire, which are critical in semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Laser processing equipment for ultra-thin glass and sapphire

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and has been recognized as a national high-tech enterprise.
